title: Hands the matching results of the two password fields to the browser
goal: Supplement cross-field validation with setCustomValidity and clear old errors after correction.
summary: needs to be entered repeatedly when setting the local device password. After any field changes, the validity of the confirmation box must be recalculated.
tasks: monitors the input of #password and #confirm. If the confirmation box is not empty and the two values ​​are different, set a custom error "Two passwords are inconsistent" and display the same sentence in #feedback.
value matches or the confirmation box is empty. The confirmation box's required still takes effect.

example.code:
const message = amount < minimum ? 'quantity is lower than the lower limit' : '';
field.setCustomValidity(message);
example.note: Passing in a non-empty string will invalidate the control. Passing in an empty string will clear the custom error.

hint: Two input boxes can share a check function. Use confirm.value to compare without accessing the HTML value attribute.
